Game Overview

Happy Candy is a arcade game built around guide adorable, candy-loving monsters through whimsical worlds filled with challenging obstacles. Collect delicious candies and shimmering coins to unlock more creatures. Navigate with precision to avoid the deadly thorns and spikes in this vibrant arcade adventure that tests your timing and skill. Indulge in addictive fun!
